Bitdeer Technologies.why: converts its ~3 GW powered-land portfolio into AI data-center capacity: a 16-year, ~$4.7 billion colocation lease at Tydal, Norway (121 IT MW for NVIDIA GPUs) and its own Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 / Vera Rubin) - its revenue grows directly with AI compute build-out
Bitdeer Technologies.evidence: Bitdeer Technologies Q2 FY2026 (08-10-2026), CSO Haris Basit: subsidiary Tydal Data Center AS executed a 16-year colocation lease and services agreement with Volta at the Tydal campus, delivering 121 IT MW configured to run NVIDIA GPUs, approximately $4.7 billion in contracted base-term revenue

players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer AI Secures 65.1MW A202 Facility at Its Existing (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bitdeer AI entered into a 10-year data center services agreement for A202, a 65.1MW AI Cloud data center on its Johor Bahru, Malaysia campus (next to the 21.7MW A201), with energization expected in Q3 2027; A202 is designed for liquid-cooled, rack-scale NVIDIA systems including GB300 NVL72 and Vera Rubin. The Johor campus totals 86.8MW of AI Cloud capacity. Secured AI Cloud data center capacity now totals approximately 206.5MW across Malaysia, Norway and the US, approximately 59% of its target of up to 350MW to be delivered by the first quarter of 2028. Per-MW economics of A202 are expected to be broadly consistent with A102, where 5-year offtake commitments represent over $800 million of expected revenue across 9.5MW; GPU deployment to be funded mainly by customer prepayments (sought to cover more than 50% of the capex).
quarterly_data.figure: A202 65.1MW (energization Q3 2027); secured ~206.5MW of up to 350MW target by Q1 2028; A102 >$800 million over 5 years on 9.5MW

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer AI Secures 65.1MW A202 Facility at Its Existing (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Michael Potter: demand for liquid-cooled, rack-scale AI Cloud capacity in 2027 is running well ahead of what the market can supply; A102 sold out ahead of energization and A201 is in advanced negotiations. VP of AI Cloud Retainna Lin: A201 is scheduled to be ready for service in January 2027. Bitdeer AI's active pipeline for AI cloud capacity is now estimated to exceed $7 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: active AI cloud pipeline >$7 billion; A201 ready for service January 2027
